annotation.interpretation_a: The entire ClientHello message, including extensions, must be resubmitted without any changes beyond the key_share replacement.
annotation.interpretation_b: Only the key_share extension (if present) and its contents are subject to the 'without modification' constraint; other extensions and fields in the ClientHello can be modified.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'without modification' is incomplete. It doesn't specify *what* is not to be modified. This allows for interpretations where either the entire message is unchanged, or only the key_share extension is unchanged.
annotation.missing_information: It is unclear whether 'without modification' applies to the entire ClientHello message or only to the key_share extension. A missing constraint specifying the scope of 'without modification' leads to different implementations.
